angleRead.name: Trevor Shimizu
angleRead.text: I’m looking at the numbers for 12th St Oakland City Center—ridership down 9,631 compared to last cycle. Fog, holidays, game days, and events downtown seem to have hit hard. The Baylight District’s final council vote on construction planning might’ve added to the chaos. I want to talk to the transit workers who were on the ground during this period. What did they see? How did they manage the delays? I’m particularly curious about the operators and station managers—those who deal directly with the public during these disruptions.
